title: Ethene and propene
caption: Each alkene has one C=C and fits CₙH₂ₙ. The two carbons of the double bond and the four atoms attached to them all lie in one plane.
alt: Displayed formulae of ethene and propene with the C=C highlighted.
description: Ethene, C₂H₄: two carbons joined by a double bond, each with two hydrogens.
Propene, C₃H₆: a CH₃ on one carbon of the double bond.
